latin: Quid sit intelligendum per capras apud Zoroastrem intelliget qui legerit in libro Bair quae sit affinitas capris et quae agnis cum spiritibus.
latin_note: 'Bair' is Pico's spelling of the Bahir; kept as printed.
translation: Whoever reads in the book Bahir what kinship the she-goats have, and what the lambs have, with spirits will grasp what the she-goats mean in Zoroaster.
